title: Draft PR #183 has an open SonarQube Cloud c:S1186 issue for its intentional Apache log wrapper

summary: SonarQube Cloud had reported open c:S1186 at ci/checks/connectors/apache/apache_rules_set_cleanup.c:173 because the linker-wrap stub __wrap_ap_log_perror_ is intentionally empty. Final PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 contains one behavior-neutral explanatory in-body comment; its PR Quality Gate was OK and its direct PR issue API total was 0. The head was merged as Parent master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 with the same tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0, and all 14 master-SHA workflows succeeded. These facts do not establish a direct Sonar master analysis or master issue query, so the finding remains fixed, not verified or closed.

root_cause: The no-op test-harness wrapper intentionally discards Apache log output but does not document that intent in its function body, triggering Sonar's empty-function maintainability rule.

proposed_remediation: Keep the minimal explanatory in-function comment without changing the wrapper's no-op behavior. Run a direct SonarQube Cloud analysis and issue query for resulting master before verified or closed status; do not infer those results from the PR receipt, tree identity, or master workflow success.
